MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 6th June, 2023 


8.0. 2477(E).—In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (l) of section 3A of the National 
Highways Act, 956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after 
being satisfied that for the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule 
below, is required for building (widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four laning etc.,), maintenance, 
management and operation of NH59A in the stretch of land from Km. 00.2 to Km. 26 (Sub Divisional 
Officer (R), Khategaon, District-Dewas) in the district of DEWAS in the state of MADHYA PRADESH, 
hereby declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of 
this notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub- 
section(]) of section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, Sub Divisional Officer 
(R), Khategaon in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the 
objector an opportunity of being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all 
such objections and after making such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, 
by order, either allow or disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act 
shall be final. 


The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available and 
can be inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

NOTIFICATION 
Mumbai, the 6th June 2023 


S.O. 2500(E).— Whereas, by the notification of the Government of India, in the Ministry of 
Railways (Railway Board), number, S.O 49 (E) dated the 23rd March 2023 published in Gazette of India, 
Extraordinary, Part II, section 3 Sub-section (ii), dated the 24th March 2023 (hereinafter referred to as the 
said notification ) and issued under sub-section () of section 20(A) of the Railway Act, 989 (24 of 989) 
(hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declares its intention to acquire the land 
specified in the schedule annexed to the said notification for the purpose of execution, maintenance, 
management and operation of Special Railway Project, namely Nimach-Ratlam Doubling Project in the 
State of Madhya Pradesh; 


And whereas, the substance of the said notification was published in daily newspapers namely 
“Dainik Bhaskar (Hindi)’, “Raj Express (Hindi)”, “Dashpur Express (Hindi)”, “Malav Darshan (Hindi)”, 
“Free Press Journal (English)” & “Times of India (English) on 30th March 2023 by Additional Collector 
and Competent Authority, Ratlam (M.P.) under sub section (4) of section 20A of the said Act; And 
whereas, no objections have been received by Competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (I) of section 20E of the said Act, the competent 
authority has submitted its report of the Central Government; 


Now therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the Competent Authority, and in exercise of the 
powers conferred by sub-section (l) of section 20E of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that the land specified in the schedule annexed hereto shall be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 20E of the said Act, the Central Government 
here by declares that on publication of this notification in the official Gazette, the land specified in the 
schedule annexed hereto shall vest absolutely in the Central government free from all encumbrances.

MINISTRY OF RAILWAYS

NOTIFICATION 
Mumbai, the 6th June 2023 
S.O. 2498(E).—In exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (I) of section 20A of the 
Railways Act, 1989 (24 of 1989) (herein after referred in as the said Act), the Central Government after 
being satisfied that for the public purpose, the land, the brief description of, which is given in the schedule 


annexed hereto, is required for execution of Nimach-Ratlam doubling Project in the State of Madhya 
Pradesh, hereby declares its intention to acquire such land; 


Any person interested in the said land may, within a period of thirty days from the date of 
publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, raise objection to the acquisition and use of such land 
for a foresaid purpose under sub-section (1) of section 20D of the said Act;

Every such objection shall be made to the competent authority, namely, Additional Collector & 
Competent Authority, District- Ratlam (M.P.), in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the 
competent authority shall give the objector an opportunity of being heard, either in person or by legal 
practitioner and may, after hearing all such objections and after making such further enquiry, if any as the 
competent authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or disallow the objections; 


Any order made by the competent authority under sub-section (II) of section 20(D) of the said act 
shall be final; 


The Map (plan) of the land coming under this notification can be seen in the office of Additional 
Collector & Competent Authority, Ratlam and Deputy Chief Engineer (Construction) Western Railway, 
Ratlam.

NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 6th June, 2023 


S.O. 2472(E).—In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highways 
Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for 
the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required for building 
(widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four laning etc.,), maintenance, management and operation of stretch of land 
in Jagadhari-Paonta Sahib section of NH-73A (New NH-907) from Km. 0.000 to Km. 52.794 in the District of 
YAMUNANAGAR in the state of HARYANA, hereby declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section(1) of 
section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, District Revenue Officer, 
Yamunanagar in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector an 
opportunity of being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections and

disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be final. 


The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available and can be 
inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 6th June, 2023 


S.O. 2466 (E).—Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, number S.O 3970(E) Dated 23.08.2022 and S.O. 2l6(E) Dated 4.03.2023 , published in the Gazette 
of India, Extraordinary, Part I, Section 3, Sub-section (ii) issued under sub-section (.) of section 3A of the National 
Highway Act, 956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its 
intention to acquire the land specified in the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building of (Widening/two 
lane with paved shoulder/four laning etc.) Maintenance, management and operation of National Highway |67K on the 
stretch of land from Km 96.000 to Km 24.000 & 43.600 to Km. 73.560 (Sangameswaram to Nandyal) in the 
district of Nandyal in the state of ANDHRA PRADESH 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Andhra jyothi(Telugu)” and “The 
Hindu (English) both dated 3/.08.2022; and Andhra Prabha (Telugu) and “The Hindu (English) both dated 
36.03. 2023 under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
competent Authority; 


28 THE GAZETTE OF INDIA : EXTRAORDINARY [PART II—SEC. 3(ii)] 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (.) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

आपत्तिकर्ता को व्यक्तिगत रूप में या किसी विधिक पेशेवर द्वारा सुने जाने का अवसर देगा और ऐसी आपत्तियों की सुनवाई 
के पश्चात्‌ तथा ऐसी और जाँच करने के पश्चात्‌, यदि कोई हो, जिसे सक्षम प्राधिकारी आवश्यक समझे, आदेश द्वारा या तो

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 6th June, 2023 


S.O. 2481(E).—In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highways 
Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for 
the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required for building 
(widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four laning etc.,), maintenance, management and operation of NH752D 
(Spur) in the stretch of land from Km. 47.700 to Km. 86.500 (Ujjain-Badnawar Section) in the district of UJJAIN in 
the state of MADHYA PRADESH, hereby declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section (1) of 
section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, Sub Divisional Officer (R), 
Barnagar in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector an 
opportunity of being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections and 
after making such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or 
disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be 
final. 


The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available and can be 
inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

का.आ. 2499(अ).--केन्द्रीय सरकार रेल अधिनियम, 1989 (1989 का 24) (जिसे इसमें इसके पश्चात उक्त 
अधिनियम कहा गया है) की धारा 20क के उपखंड (|) खण्ड द्वारा प्रदत शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुये, ये समाधान हो जाने 
के पश्चात कि लोक प्रयोजन के लिए, यह भूमि, जिसका संक्षिप्त विवरण इससे उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में दिया गया है, मध्यप्रदेश 
राज्य के रतलाम जिले में नीमच-रतलाम दोहरीकरण परियोजना नाम की विशेष रेल परियोजना के निष्पादन के लिये 
आवश्यक है, ऐसी भूमि के अर्जन करने के आशय की घोषणा करती है; 

उक्त भूमि मे हितबद्ध कोई व्यक्ति, राजपत्र में इस अधिसूचना के प्रकाशन की तारीख से तीस दिन के भीतर, उक्त 
अधिनियम की धारा 20घ की उप-धारा (1) के अधीन उपर्युक्त प्रयोजन के ऐसी भूमि के अर्जज और उपयोग के संबंध में 
आक्षेप कर सकेगा; 

प्रत्येक आक्षेप सक्षम प्राधिकारी अर्थात, अपर कलेक्टर एवं सक्षम अधिकारी, रतलाम (मध्यप्रदेश) को लिखित रूप 
में किया जावेगा और उसके आधारो को उपवर्णित करेगा। सक्षम प्राधिकारी आक्षेपकर्ता को या तो व्यक्तिगत रूप से या विधि 
व्यवसायी (अधिवक्ता) के माध्यम से सुने जाने का अवसर प्रदान करेगा और ऐसे सभी आक्षेपों की सुनवाई करने के पश्चात 


और ऐसी अतिरिक्त जांच करने के पश्चात, यदि कोई हो, जो सक्षम प्राधिकारी आवश्यक समझे, आदेश द्वारा आक्षेपों को या 
तो मंजूर कर सकेगा या नामंजूर कर सकेगा;

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 6th June, 2023 


S.O. 2488(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways,S.O. 837(E) Dated 22.02.2023, published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, 
Sub-section (1) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) 
(hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and 
operation of National Highway 753L on the stretch of Boregaon Buzurg to Muktainagar (from Km. 139.000 to Km. 
216.000) within the stretch of land from Km. 192.700 to Km. 195+160 and Km. 199+360 to Km. 216+000 in the 
District of JALGAON in the state of MAHARASHTRA. 


14 THE GAZETTE OF INDIA : EXTRAORDINARY [PART II—SEC. 3(ii)] 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Lokmat” and “Times of India” 
both dated 01.03.2023; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
Competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Competent Authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the Competent Authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 6th June, 2023 


S.O. 2485(E).—Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, 1657 Dated : 06/04/2023 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part I, Section 3, 
Sub-section (1) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) 
(hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and 
operation of NH344P in the stretch of land from Km. 4.500 to Km. 25.300 (District Revenue Officer cum Land 
Acquisition Collector Sonipat , DC Office , Gohana Road , Sonipat - 131001) in the district of SONIPAT in the state 
of HARYANA; 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Dainik Jagran” and “The Times 
of India” both dated 14 April 2023; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
Competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Competent Authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the Competent Authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

अतः अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, सक्षम प्राधिकारी की उक्त रिपोर्ट प्राप्त हो जाने पर और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ

पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ; 


और अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (2) के अनुसरण में यह घोषणा करती है कि 
इस अधिसूचना के राजपत्र में प्रकाशन पर, उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि सभी विल्लंगमों से मुक्त होकर आत्यन्तिक रूप 
से केन्द्रीय सरकार में निहित हो जाएगी ।

S.O. 2467(E).—Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, S.O. 5445(E) dated 23 November 2022, published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, 
Section 3, Sub-section (ii) issued under sub-section () of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 956 (48 of 956) 
(hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for construction of (Widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four laning 
etc.) Maintenance, management and operation of NH327E on the stretch of land from Km. !8 to Km. |22 (District

And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Danik Jagaran” and “Danik 
Bhaskar” both dated 28-2-2022, 29-2-2022 under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
Competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (.) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 6th June, 2023 


S.O. 2470(E).— In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highways 
Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for 
the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required for building 
(widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four laning etc.,), maintenance, management and operation of New 
Construction of Major Bridge with Approaches from Km. 0.000 to 1.200 (Madhopur—Badabanta Section) of NH—20 
under NH (O) in Annual Plan 2022-23 in the State of Odisha. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section(1) of 
section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, Additional Tahasildar, Jajpur in 
writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector an opportunity of 
being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections and after making 
such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or disallow the 
objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be 
final. 

The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available and can be 
inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

S.O. 2483(E).—In exercise of the powers conferred by the Sub-Section (i) of Section 3A of the National 
Highways Act, 956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being 
satisfied that for the public purpose, the land the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required 
for "Widening and Strengthening of existing NH-l6B from Km 25.500 to Km 4.000" in connection with 
the “Preparation of Detailed Project Report for Rehabilitation and Up-gradation to 2-Lane with Paved 
Shoulders Configuration of Nandakumar-Contai-Digha-Chandaneshwar Road (0.000 Km. to 90.775 Km.) 
along with Contai Bye-pass (3.30 Km.) (Total Length 94.075 Km.) of NH-l6B in the District- Purba 
Medinipur in the State of West Bengal", hereby declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one (2) days from the date of publication of this 
notification, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section (l) of section 3C of the said 
Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, Special Land Acquisition Officer, Office of 
the District Magistrate & Collector, Purba Medinipur, Village-Ganapatinagar, P.O. Uttar Sonamui, P.S. Tamluk,

shall give the objector an opportunity of being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing 
all such objections and after making such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by 
order, either allow or disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be final. 


The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available and can be inspected 
by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 6th June, 2023 


S.O. 2487 (E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub-section (ii) issued under sub- 
section (l) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the 
Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule annexed to the said 
notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and operation of NH44 on the stretch 
of land from Km 30 to Km 45! (Dhar Road Salthia Chowk Udhampur, Tehsil Udhampur) in the district of 
UDHAMPUR in the state of JAMMU & KASHMIR; 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Daily excelsior” dated 
8.0.2022 and “Umar Ujala” dated /6, /0. 2022 under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (.) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

S.O. 2490(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, 387! Dated:!7/08/2022 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub- 
section (ii) issued under sub-section (l) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter 
referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule 
annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and operation of 
NH-530B in the stretch of land from Km. 66.00 to Km. !23.l00 (Collectorate, Hathras) in the district of HATHRAS 
in the state of UTTAR PRADESH 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Hindustan (Hindi)” and “The 
Times Of India (English)” both dated 30 August 2022; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


06 THE GAZETTE OF INDIA : EXTRAORDINARY [PART II—SEC. 3(ii)] 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (.) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 6th June, 2023 


S.O. 247(E).—In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (.) of section 3A of the National Highways 
Act, 956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for 
the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required for building 
(widening/four lane with paved shoulder/six laning etc.,), maintenance, management and operation of NH-734 in the 
stretch Moradabad - Kashipur including Western Moradabad Bypass of land from Km. 0.000 to Km. 33.200 (DM 
Office Campus, Moradabad) in the district of MORADABAD in the state of UTTAR PRADESH, hereby declares its 
intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section(l) of 
section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, Special Land Acquisition 
Officer Moradabad (SLAO Office Collectorate Campus Moradabad) in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof 
and the Competent Authority shall give the objector an opportunity of being heard, either in person or by a legal 
practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections and after making such further enquiry, if any, as the 
Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be 
final. 


The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available and can 
be inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 6th June, 2023 


S.O. 2482(E).—In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highways 
Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for 
the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required for building 
(widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four laning etc.,), maintenance, management and operation of Rudrapur 
Bypass in the stretch of land from Km. 0.00 to Km. 21.476 in the district of UDHAM SINGH NAGAR in the state of 
UTTARAKHAND, hereby declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section(1) of 
section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, Special Land Acquisition Officer 
Nainital in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector an 
opportunity of being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections and 
after making such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or 
disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be final. 


The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available and can be 
inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 6th June, 2023 


S.O. 2486 (E).—Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, 56l3 Dated:0/2/2022 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub- 
section (ii) issued under sub-section (l) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter 
referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule 
annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and operation 
of Greenfield Highway in the stretch of land from Km. (5 to Km. 47 (Saharanpur) in the district of SAHARANPUR 
in the state of UTTAR PRADESH; 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Punjab Kesari” and “Times of 
India” both dated 0.2.2022; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (.) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

S.O. 2492 (E).—Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, 1371 Dated:22/03/2023 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub-

referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule 
annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and operation 
of NH965 in the stretch of land from Km. 0/000 to Km. 59/000 (CALA Pandharpur) in the district of SOLAPUR in 
the state of MAHARASHTRA

Indian Express (English)” both dated 30.03.2023; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 6th June, 2023 


S.O. 249] (E).—Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, 8.00. 97 (E) Dated O5th January , 2023. published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part I, 
Section 3, Sub-section (ii) issued under sub-section (l) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 956 (48 of 956) 
(hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and 
operation of NH-354 in the stretch of land from Km. 0.00 to Km. 44.54 in the district of AMRITS AR in the state of 
PUNJAB 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “The Times of India English” and 
“Ajit Punjabi” both dated 3/0I/2023 under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (.) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

का.आ. 2489(अ).--केन्द्रीय सरकार ने, राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम, 1956 (1956 का 48) (जिसे इसमें इसके 
पश्चात्‌ उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है) की धारा 3क की उपधारा (1) के अधीन जारी की गई भारत सरकार के सड़क 
परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. 560 तारीख 03/02/2023, जो भारत के राजपपत्र, 
असाधारण, भाग 1, खण्ड 3, उपखंड (1) में प्रकाशित की गई थी, द्वारा तेलंगाना राज्य के करीमनगर जिले में |॥1563 के 
कि.मी. 26.3 से कि.मी.59.353 (करीमनगर) तक के राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग के निर्माण (चौड़ाकरने / चार लेन का बनाने, आदि), 


अनुरक्षण, प्रबंधन और प्रचालन के लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने 
आशय की घोषणा की थी ; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3क की उपधारा (3) के अधीन तारीख तारीख 
"09.02.2023"को"द हिन्दू"और"मना तेलंगाना" दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 


और आक्षेप प्राप्त हुए थे और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उन पर विचार कर लिया है और आक्षेपों को अननुज्ञात कर दिया 
है; 

और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (1) के अनुसरण में, केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी 
रिपोर्ट दे दी है;

अतः अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, सक्षम प्राधिकारी की उक्त रिपोर्ट प्राप्त हो जाने पर और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ 
की उपधारा (1) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, यह घोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का 
पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ; 

और अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (2) के अनुसरण में यह घोषणा करती है कि 
इस अधिसूचना के राजपत्र में प्रकाशन पर, उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि सभी विल्लंगमों से मुक्त होकर आत्यन्तिक रूप 
से केन्द्रीय सरकार में निहित हो जाएगी ।

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 6th June, 2023 


S.O. 2489(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, S.0.560 (E) Dated:03/02/2023 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part वी, Section 3, 
Sub-section (ii) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) 
(hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and 
operation of NH563 in the stretch of land from Km. 26.3 to Km. 59.353 (Karimnagar) in the district of 
KARIMNAGAR in the state of TELANGANA. 


26 THE GAZETTE OF INDIA : EXTRAORDINARY [PART II—SEC. 3(ii)] 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “The Hindu” and “Mana 
Telangana” both Dated 09.02.2023; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

(पी.एन.सी.पी.एल.) का प्रस्तावित आर.ओ.यू. इंद्रधनुष गैस ग्रिड लिमिटेड की गुवाहाटी - नुमालीगढ़ प्राकृतिक गैस 
पाइपलाइन (जी.एन.पी.एल.) के उदलगुड़ी (असम) जिले में 26.79 कि. मी. के लिए समान मार्ग से गुजरता है। 


नुमालीगढ़ रिफाइनरी लिमिटेड की पारादीप नुमालीगढ़ कच्चा तेल पाइपलाइन (पी.एन.सी.पी.एल.) और इंद्रधनुष 
गैस ग्रिड लिमिटेड की गुवाहाटी - नुमालीगढ़ प्राकृतिक गैस पाइपलाइन (जी.एन.पी.एल.) के लगभग 26.79 कि.मी. में 
समान ALAA, कॉरिडोर का उपयोग करने का प्रस्ताव रखा है, जिसे शुरू में इंद्रधनुष गैस ग्रिड लिमिटेड द्वारा अधिग्रहित 
किया गया था। जो पहले ही इंद्रधनुष गैस ग्रिड लिमिटेड द्वारा भारत के राजपत्र में प्रकाशित है, जिसकी अधिसूचना संख्या 
का.आ. 340(अ) दिनांक 21 जनवरी, 2021 को भारत के राजपत्र संख्या 309 दिनांक 22 जनवरी, 2021, का.आ. 
4489(अ) दिनांक 25 अक्तूबर, 2021 को भारत के राजपत्र संख्या 4131 दिनांक 28 अक्तूबर, 2021, का.आ. 3948(अ) 
दिनांक 12 अगस्त, 2022 को भारत के राजपत्र संख्या 3774 दिनांक 23 अगस्त, 2022, का.आ. 4729(अ) दिनांक 
30 सितम्बर, 2022 को भारत के राजपत्र संख्या 4519 दिनांक 06 अक्तूबर, 2022 में प्रकाशित किया गया। 


अतः अब उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 6 की उपधारा (4) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, केंद्रीय सरकार 
एतद द्वारा निर्देश देती है कि उक्त भूमि में पाइपलाइन बिछाने के लिए प्रयोक्ता का अधिकार, इस घोषणा के प्रकाशित होने 
की तारीख से, इंद्रधनुष गैस ग्रिड लिमिटेड के गुवाहाटी - नुमालीगढ़ प्राकृतिक गैस पाइपलाइन (जी.एन.पी.एल.) के साथ - 
साथ नुमालीगढ़ रिफाइनरी लिमिटेड कि पारादीप नुमालीगढ़ कच्चा तेल पाइपलाइन (पी.एन.सी.पी.एल.) का भी भूमि में 
संयुक्त रूप से निहित होगा और 26.79 कि. मी. उदलगुड़ी (असम) जिले में सभी प्रकार के विल्लंगमों से मुक्त संयुक्त रूप से

MINISTRY OF PETROLEUM AND NATURAL GAS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 5th June, 2023 


S.O. 2446(E).—Whereas Numaligarh Refinery Limited, is now proposed to lay Paradip Numaligarh Crude 
Oil Pipeline (PNCPL) for transportation of Crude Oil from Paradip (Odisha) to Numaligarh (Assam). The proposed 
ROU of Paradip Numaligarh Crude Oil Pipeline (PNCPL) traverses in the same route that of Indradhanush Gas Grid 
Limited’s Guwahati-Numaligarh Natural Gas Pipeline (GNPL) for 26.79 Km. in Udalguri (Assam) District. 


Numaligarh Refinery Limited proposes to make use of about 26.79 Km. common ROU corridor of 
Indradhanush Gas Grid Limited’s Guwahati - Numaligarh Natural Gas Pipeline (GNPL), which was acquired initially 
by Indradhanush Gas Grid Limited published in Central Gazette vide, S.O. 340(E) Dated 21 January, 2021 published 
in the Central Gazette No. 309 dated 22 January, 2021, S.O. 4489(E) Dated 25 October, 2021 published in the Central 
Gazette No. 4131 dated 28 October, 2021, 8.00. 3948(E) Dated 12 August, 2022 published in the Central Gazette No. 
3774 dated 23 August, 2022, S.O. 4729(E) Dated 30 September, 2022 published in the Central Gazette No. 4519 
dated 06 October, 2022. 


Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (4) of section 6 of the said Act, the 
Central Government hereby directs that the right of user in the lands as specified in the schedule appended to this 
notification for laying the pipeline shall, Jointly vest on the date publication of the declaration, in the Indradhanush 
Gas Grid Limited for laying the Guwahati - Numaligarh Natural Gas Pipeline (GNPL) as well as for laying Paradip 
Numaligarh Crude Oil Pipeline (PNCPL) by Numaligarh Refinery Limited for 26.79 Km. in Udalguri (Assam) 
District free from all encumbrances.

NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 7th June, 2023 


S.O. 259(E).—Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Petroleum and 
Natural Gas, published Vide Gazette No. 552 Part II, Section 3 Sub-section (ii) dated 47 November 2022, S.O. 
No. 5378 (E) dated 6 November 2022 issued under sub-section (i) of section 3 of the Petroleum and Minerals 
Pipelines (Acquisition of Right of User in Land) Act, 962 (50 of 962), (Hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the 
Central Government declared its intention to acquire the right of user in the land situated in Taluka — Viramgam, 
District Ahmedabad in Gujarat State, specified in the schedule appended to that notification for the purpose of laying 
pipeline for the transportation of petroleum product from Kandla in the State Gujarat to Gorakhpur in the State Uttar 
Pradesh by the IHB Ltd. for implementing the “Kandla-Gorakhpur LPG Pipeline Project” 


And whereas the copies of the said Gazette notification were made available to the concerned public up to 
0.02.2023. And whereas, Mr. K.R. Undkat, Competent Authority, Sub Divisional Magistrate, Sanand, Dist. 
Ahmedabad, State — Gujarat has under sub-section () of section 6 of the said Act, has submitted his report to the 
Central Government. 


And whereas, the Central Government, after considering the said report and on being satisfied that the said 
land is required for laying the pipeline has decided to acquire right of user therein; 


Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (l) of section 6 of the said Act, the 
Central Government hereby declares that the right of user in the land specified in the schedule appended to this 
notification is hereby acquired for laying the pipeline.

E.3 Examination by the Authority 


With regard to circumvention of the existing anti-dumping duties, Section 9A(/A) of the Act provides as under: 


“Where the Central Government, on such inquiry as it may consider necessary, is of the opinion that 
circumvention of anti-dumping duty imposed under sub-section (l) has taken place, either by altering the 
description or name or composition of the article subject to such anti-dumping duty or by import of such 
article in an unassembled or disassembled form or by changing the country of its origin or export or in any 
other manner, whereby the anti-dumping duty so imposed is rendered ineffective, it may extend the anti- 
dumping duty to such article or an article originating in or exported from such country, as the case may 
be." 


24. Rule 25 of the Anti-dumping Rules states as follows: 


“25. Circumvention of anti-dumping duty.— (2) Circumvention shall be considered as a change in the 
pattern of trade between any country and India or between individual companies in any country subject to 
measures and India, as a result of a practice, process or work for which there is insufficient cause or 
economic justification other than the imposition of the duty; and where there is evidence of injury or that the 
remedial effects of the duty are being undermined in terms of the prices or quantities or both of the like 
product; and where there is evidence of dumping in relation to the normal values previously established for 
the like product, if necessary with appropriate changes or adjustments or in accordance with the provisions 
of rule 0. 


(2) The practice, process or work referred to in the sub-rule () includes, inter alia, - 


(a) where an article subject to anti-dumping duty is imported into India from any country including 
the country of origin or country of export notified for the purposes of levy of anti-dumping duty, in

(b) where an article subject to anti-dumping duty is imported into India from country of origin or

variation of tariff classification, if any; 


(c) where an article subject to anti-dumping duty is imported into India through any exporter or

In the present case, the applicant has alleged circumvention of the existing anti-dumping duties under the 
provisions of Rule 25(2)(c) of the Rules, that is, through imports of the subject goods through a country not 
subject to antidumping duty. The Authority has examined the alleged circumvention of existing anti-dumping 
duties on China via exports through Malaysia. In order to examine the same, the Authority has considered 
transaction-wise data procured from DG Systems. 


The Authority notes that the anti-dumping measure is producer/exporter specific. The producers/ exporters 
subjected to an anti-dumping investigation need to provide relevant data/information so that the Authority can 
make a determination. Further, the Authority sent questionnaires to the known producers/exporters from the 
circumventing country, advising them to provide information in the form and manner prescribed by the 
Authority. However, the Authority notes that none of the exporters from Malaysia has responded in the present 
investigation. 


In view of the above, the Authority has examined the information available on record before the Authority as 
filed by the domestic industry.

F.l Determination of Normal Value 


42. None of the exporters have filed any comment or submission with regard to normal value. According to Rule 
25 of the Rules, the Authority is required to consider the normal value previously established for the like 
product (with due adjustments). The normal value was previously determined for China, considering Chinese 
producers as operating in a non-market economy. Therefore, the Authority is required to adopt the normal value 
previously determined with appropriate changes. Since the said normal value was determined in accordance 
with Para 7 of Annexure I to the Rules, the Authority considers that the normal value is required to be 
determined considering the same legal provisions. 


43. It is noted that there is no information available on the price or constructed value in a market economy third 
country. The applicant has proposed imports into India from Thailand as the basis for the determination of 
normal value. It is seen that the same basis has been proposed by the applicant in the parallel ongoing sunset 
review investigation relating to the same product from China. There is no information available on the price or 
constructed value in a market economy third country. Since information is available on the second option, i.e., 
the price from such a third country to other country, including India, in the form of the import price of the 
subject goods from Thailand to India, the Authority considers it appropriate to adopt the import price from 
Thailand to India for the purpose of determination of normal value. It is noted that Thailand has no anti- 
dumping investigation or any trade remedial measure in the product, and the volume of imports in the POI is 
significant. 

44. In view of the above and considering the lack of participation from any other interested party, the Authority has 
determined normal value on the basis of the import prices of the subject goods from Thailand to India. Since 
the said price is at CIF level, the Authority has determined ex-factory export price by appropriately adjusting 
the same for expenses from CIF to ex-factory level. Accordingly, the normal value determined is ***. 


F.2 Export price of the product under investigation 


45. The Authority sent questionnaires to the known producers/exporters from the circumventing country, advising 
them to provide information in the form and manner prescribed by the Authority. However, none of the 
producers/exporters responded nor filed any responses to the questionnaires. The Authority has hence 
determined the export price on the basis of the data procured from DG systems data. 


46. The Authority notes that the DG systems data shows imports of ,906 MT of the product under investigation 
during the POI. The CIF export price determined from DG Systems data has been adjusted for ocean freight, 
marine insurance, commission, bank charges, port expenses, and inland freight charges on the basis of facts 
available to determine the export price at the ex-factory level. The net export price so determined is US$ 
4.98/Kg. 


#.3 Dumping margin of the product under investigation

dumping margin has thus been worked, which is as follows:

H. POST-DISCLOSURE COMMENTS 


मर. Submissions made by the other interested parties 
None of the exporters, importers, consumers, and any other interested parties has filed any comment or 
submissions, post-issuance of the disclosure statement. 

H.2 Submissions made by the domestic industry 
The domestic industry has filed the following comments, post issuance of the disclosure statement: 

a. There is a significant change in the pattern of trade without any due cause or justification other than the 
anti-dumping duty in force. 

b. The dumping margin for PUI exported from Malaysia is positive and significant. 

c. The exports of the PUI from Malaysia are of Chinese origin and they are being exported to India falsely 
claiming as goods originating in Malaysia. 

d. The imports of the subject goods from Malaysia are at dumped prices and are undercutting the prices of 
the domestic industry and consequently adversely impacting the domestic industry by undermining the 
remedial effects of the existing anti-dumping measure. 

e. There exists erosion of duties in the case of the PUI. 

H.3 Examination by the Authority 
The Authority has examined the post-disclosure submissions made by the domestic industry and notes that 


most of the submissions are reiterations which have already been examined suitably and addressed adequately 
in relevant paras of this final findings. 


I. CONCLUSION 


Having initiated the present investigation and after examining the contentions of the domestic industry and the 
other interested parties and on the basis of the analysis as above, the Authority concludes as under: 


a.There has been a change in the pattern of trade post imposition of anti-dumping duties in the case of the PUI 


for which there is no due cause or economic justification other than the existing anti-dumping duties. The 
imports from Malaysia which were in negligible quantities during the POI of the original investigation 
increased significantly over the injury period while imports from China PR declined after imposition of 
anti-dumping duties and is negligible in the POI. In fact, the imports of subject goods from Malaysia 
increased from .57 MT (20I5-6) to ,906 MT in the POI of the present investigation while imports from 
China PR declined from 066 MT to 6 MT during the same period. 


. Despite a significant decline in imports from China PR, the Indian industry which are unorganized, 


fragmented and which falls in the MSME category lost its market share to the imports of PUI from 
Malaysia compared to the original investigation. Malaysia had an insignificant market share during the POI 
of the original investigation which increased to 6% in 209-20 and to 3% in 202-22. The imports of PUI 
from Malaysia are very significant in the POI of the present investigation, and is more than the imports 
from China in the original investigation, resulting in the decline of the market share of Indian industry

during the injury period. The Indian industry was not able to recover its market share with the existing 
duties on China PR, as it suffered loss in market share due to imports of PUI from Malaysia. 


c.The imports of PUI from Malaysia are entering the Indian market at significantly dumped prices and are 
undercutting the prices of the domestic industry. 


d. The import of PUI has undermined the remedial effect of the existing anti-dumping measure on the PUC 
imposed vide Customs Notification No. 20/208-Customs (ADD) dated 0" April 208. 


e.Since the dumping margin is above de minimis, the commercial gain due to the erosion of anti-dumping duty 
on the PUC has benefitted producers/exporters by exporting the PUI.

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 7th June, 2023 


S.O. 2503(E).— In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highways 
Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for 
the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required for building 
(widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four laning etc.,), maintenance, management and operation of NHNE 4C in 
the stretch of land from Km. 9.25 to Km. 32.74 (collectorate office, Dausa) in the district of DAUSA in the state of 
RAJASTHAN, hereby declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section(1) of 
section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, SDO Dausa in writing and shall set 
out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector an opportunity of being heard, either in 
person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections and after making such further enquiry, if 
any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be 
final. 


The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available and can be 
inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
Competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section () of section 3D of the said Act, the Competent Authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the Competent Authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose;

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 7th June, 2023 

S.O. 2511(E)— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road 
Transport and Highways, Department of Ministry of Road Transport and Highway number S.O. 427 (E) 
dated 25.01.2023, published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub-section (ii) 
issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter 
referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building (widening /two-laning etc.) Maintenance, 
management and operation of NH-752C on the stretch of land from Km 33+100 to Km. 43+500 (Pachore 
to Shujalpur Road) (Section-1) (Shujalpur-Bypass) in the district of Shajapur, in the state of MADHYA 
PRADESH 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Dainik Jagran" 
16 February 2023 Thursday, And "Free Press'' both dated 16 February 2023 Thursday, under sub- 
section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by 
the competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent 
authority has submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the 
powers conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that the land specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central 
Government hereby declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land 
specified in the said Schedule shall vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

पश्चात्‌ उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है) की धारा 3क की उपधारा (1) के अधीन जारी की गई भारत सरकार के सड़क 
परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. 1759 तारीख 17/04/2023, जो भारत के राजपत्र, 
असाधारण, भाग 1, खण्ड 3, उपखंड (ii) A प्रकाशित की गई थी, द्वारा आंध्र प्रदेश राज्य के चित्तूर जिले में NHNE-7 के 
कि.मी. 71 से कि.मी.96 (कलक्टरेट बिल्डिन्‌, चित्तूर) तक के राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग के निर्माण (चौड़ाकरने / चार लेन का बनाने, 
आदि), अनुरक्षण, प्रबंधन और प्रचालन के लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन करने के 
अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी ; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3क की उपधारा (3) के अधीन तारीख 20.04.2023 को 
हिन्दू" हिन्दी भाषा और "आंध्र ज्योति" तेलुगु भाषा दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 


और आक्षेप प्राप्त हुए थे और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उन पर विचार कर लिया है और आक्षेपों को अननुज्ञात कर दिया 
है;

और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (1) के अनुसरण में, केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी 
रिपोर्ट दे दी है; 


अतः अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, सक्षम प्राधिकारी की उक्त रिपोर्ट प्राप्त हो जाने पर और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ 
की उपधारा (1) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, यह घोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का 
पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ; 


और अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (2) के अनुसरण में यह घोषणा करती है कि 
इस अधिसूचना के राजपत्र में प्रकाशन पर, उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि सभी विल्लंगमों से मुक्त होकर आत्यन्तिक रूप 
से केन्द्रीय सरकार में निहित हो जाएगी ।

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 6th June, 2023 


S.O. 2464 (E)— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, S.0.1759(E) Dated:17/04/2023 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, 
Sub-section (ii) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) 
(hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and 
operation of NHNE-7 in the stretch of land from Km. 71 to Km. 96 (collectorate building, chittoor) in the district of 
Chittor in the state of ANDHRA PRADESH 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “The Hindu” in English Language 


and “Andhra Jyothi” in Telugu Language both dated 20.04.2023; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


14 THE GAZETTE OF INDIA : EXTRAORDINARY [PART II—SEC. 3(ii)] 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 


competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 


submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 


specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 


vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 7th June, 2023 


S.O. 258(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub-section (i) issued under sub- 
section (l) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, !956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the 
Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule annexed to the said 
notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and operation of NH 754K on the 
stretch of land from Km 84.478 to Km 244.38] (Bikaner) in the district of BIKANER in the state of RAJASTHAN 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Rajasthan Patrika” and “Dainik 
Bhaskar” both dated 07.02.2023; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
competent Authority; 

And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 

Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (.) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 

And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.
